title: How to clean a dishwasher filter

pieces.say: You've been cleaning your dishwasher wrong.
pieces.text: You've been cleaning your dishwasher wrong.
pieces.label: YOU'RE DOING IT WRONG

pieces.say: Here's the hidden part. There's a filter under the bottom spray arm.
Switch it off and pull out the bottom rack.
Twist the filter a quarter turn and lift it out.
Rinse it in warm, soapy water with a soft brush, then click it back in.
No bleach, and never mix cleaners.
Cleaner dishes, and no more funky smell.
